verdicts.reason: For a multi-tenant agent toolkit, Meta’s official WhatsApp Business Tools MCP uses OAuth-based sign-in, and Embedded Signup for partners is built on Facebook Login; this makes OAuth2 the primary auth path rather than static tokens. ([developers.facebook.com](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/mcp/whatsapp-business-tools-mcp))

verdicts.quote: “Click Request Advanced Access for each permission… [then] Submit For Review.”
verdicts.reason: Production/multi-tenant use requires App Review for Advanced access to whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management. ([developers.facebook.com](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/solution-providers/app-review/sample-submission/))

verdicts.quote: “Cloud API — Send and receive WhatsApp messages, make WhatsApp calls…” and “Groups API.”
verdicts.reason: The official overview lists multiple APIs and features (Cloud API, Business Management, Marketing Messages, Calling, Groups, Templates, Webhooks), indicating broad coverage. ([developers.facebook.com](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview/))
Meta runs an official MCP server for WhatsApp Business Tools; the claim of “none” is outdated/incorrect. ([developers.facebook.com](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/mcp))

Buildable today (self-serve getting started and OAuth sign-in), but real production/multi-tenant use is gated by App Review/Advanced access and related compliance steps (terms, verification), so caveats apply. ([developers.facebook.com](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/solution-providers/app-review/sample-submission/))
